body:
## Change

F1. Wrap debug-run transaction setup/completion failures as SnapshotStorageError, matching storage failure boundary. Same-origin database deletion can close existing connection during diagnostic persistence. Drain transaction.done rejection.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN uses fake IndexedDB deletion/versionchange closure. Parent reviewed synchronous and asynchronous failure paths, reran 9 snapshot-store tests. Worker related: 16; boundaries: 52, typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Browser-specific deletion timing not tested; deterministic fake IndexedDB exercises production connection handler. Other existing storage error wrappers unchanged. No schema/migration. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(battle): normalize debug-run storage failures
